messages:
maya: Kicking off twilight shift cutover for the US -> EU -> APAC roll. @raj @sara please confirm warm pools + pinned capacity for each region. I opened the release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2023-11-cutover :eyes:
raj: US warm pool at 120% of baseline, canary slice at 5% traffic. EU pinned to v2.3.1 for canary, capacity reservation +10%. APAC warmup in progress (estimated ETA +12m).
sara: Confirming EU pin. Observability dashboards loaded — latency SLOs green. I disabled autoscale surge for the first 15m in EU to avoid noisy scaling.
chen: APAC hostgroup nodes are still booting, ETA 8m. Thermal headroom reported as 18% on the APAC GPU pool. Will post smoke test once ready.
deploy-bot: deploy start | release=2023-11-cutover | regions=[us, eu, apac] | canary=5% | rollout_mode=sequential | initiated_by=@maya
maya: OK team, plan: roll US -> wait 20m observation -> EU pin + 10m -> APAC gradual ramp. Rollback triggers: >3% error spike or p50 latency >300ms sustained 3m, or regional thermal >=85%. If triggered, immediate traffic pinback to previous revision and notify here.
ops-oncall: Noted. I've set PagerDuty escalation baseline to level-1 for EU/APAC during the window. Also added a quick mitigation playbook snippet: `if thermal>=85% -> reduce canary to 0 -> drain new pods -> route to fallback-model`.
raj: US canary smoke: succeeded. Sample curl: `curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` returned 200 within 120ms. No errors in logs for the slice.
sara: Watching rolling metrics. Token cost looks normal. One minor 429 spike in US for 30s at minute 6, auto-retry cleared it. Keeping an eye.
chen: APAC nodes passed kube-probes, running smoke job now:
```
kubectl --context=apac-prod run smoke --image=smoke/test:latest --restart=OnFailure -- /bin/sh -c 'python smoke.py --endpoint https://apac.redwood'
```
chen: Smoke passed (3/3). Starting traffic ramp to 2% now.
maya: Good. Reminder: version pin in EU is deliberate to catch model-regression. If EU shows any quality delta against eval set >5% we hold. Sara, please run eval set after EU hits 5% traffic.
sara: Will run eval at 5% and 10%. Posting quick commands to pull the eval diff later.
deploy-bot: region-update | us:canary=5%:ok | eu:canary=0%:pending-pin | apac:canary=2%:ok
maya: EU ramping to 5% now (pinned). Everyone watch NLU drift dashboards and QoE trace.
raj: EU canary 5% smoke: OK. Latency p50 140ms, p95 310ms (steady). No error spikes.
sara: Eval run1 (5%) complete: quality delta +0.9% (within threshold). Running eval2 at 10% after we stabilize.
ops-oncall: Noting thermal: EU GPUs at 62%, APAC at 28%, US 45%. No action required.
maya: Final ramp to EU at 20% scheduled after 20m hold if all green. APAC to follow after EU steady state. Reminder: if anything hits rollback triggers we execute the `rollback-rapid-pin` doc.
chen: APAC ramp to 5% complete, p50 220ms, p95 480ms (higher due to longer tails). Monitoring.
raj: small anomaly: US token-rate hit temporary backpressure at minute 23 during a burst of long-sequence requests. We pulled back the canary to 3% for 5m and pieced logs; backpressure resolved by throttling long-seq route. No rollback needed.
maya: Good call. Documenting action: backpressure -> reduce canary by 2% -> enable route-throttle for long-seq -> observe 10m.
sara: Eval run2 (10%) results: quality delta +1.7% (within soft threshold). No regression alerts.
deploy-bot: rollout-status | us:stable | eu:canary=20% | apac:canary=5% | overall:progressing
maya: Looks good. Proceeding with planned EU full cutover after the 20m hold. APAC will be capped at 20% for first 2h, then gradual to 100% if steady.
ops-oncall: Added fallback route to older-model variant in routing layer in case we need graceful degradation: `route/weight: {new:0, old:100}` ready to apply.
chen: APAC p95 slowly trending down after backend cache warm. Now 360ms.
raj: No further anomalies in US. Can we schedule a short retro after this window to review the long-seq throttle rule?
maya: Yes — let's do 30m post-cutover quick sync. If we need to roll back anywhere, follow the rollback-rapid-pin playbook and call PD. Otherwise we'll close the window at +2h. Great job team :tada:
